Messages.Author: Sintax
Messages.Body:
1. Nik has no blood on him. My minion phase begins, and he hunts. When his
hunt
is blocked, I play change of target. Now that he has attempted to hunt and
may not repeat, can he take some other action?

SinTax!

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Empty, ready vampires cannot perform any action except "hunt".
If they cannot perform that (mandatory) action, then they are stuck,
and cannot act at all.
